# x402-research

> Scholarly search over arXiv, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar: papers, citation graphs, formatted bibliographies. Paid per query with x402: USDC on Base or Solana.

x402-research is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
